gates.why: Inspect accepted/rejected proposals and complete usage; real calls alone do not establish quality.
Importer-declared real records require independent provenance review; origin separation is not proof.
Independent author must freeze incidents before running evaluation.
Same-evidence study has not shown a semantic-slicing advantage.
Single-call full-input comparison; review coverage, failures and actual usage.
Reviews reverify evidence; notes never override UNKNOWN.
Acceptance is distinct from independently established correctness.
Run installation, tests, HTTP connector and live harness on the actual Windows laptop.
Capture three-minute demonstration and reconcile claims with evidence.
Protected single-instance deployment configuration requires an actual host test.

note: These are evidence gates, not a prediction of competition results. Uploaded reports are not cryptographically authenticated.
